personajes.profile: Tilia will always be charging at the forefront, using her shield to protect everyone. Guess only another Imperial Knight might break through her defense.

info.v: Slope Apartments 2-3 (Next to the Stargate Inn in Emor City's Ash District)
An Imperial Guard is not allowed to moonlight

skillsAuto.d:
Wields the shield and lance to launch consecutive attacks.
Strike 1: 33.4% of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG.
Strike 2: 29% of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG.
Strike 3: 47.2% of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG.
Strike 4: 47.2% of ATK as Lux Auto Attack DMG.

Hold the button to enter Fortify Stance for up to 8s, during which DEF is increased by 500.
Immune to all DMG the instant Fortify Stance is entered.
When Fortify Stance ends, casts a counterattack that deals 386% of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG and inflicts a Lux Mark: Radiance, while boosting the squad's Base ATK by 12% for 10s.

Tilia throws the Aegis of Light that bounces up to 6 times, dealing 94% of ATK as Lux Skill DMG and stunning the target for 2s, while inflicting Lux Mark: Radiance.
When this skill deals DMG, increases the squad's Base ATK by 15% for 10s.

Leaps and slams down onto the ground, dealing 771% of ATK as Lux Ultimate DMG in a large area. Meanwhile, creates a sphere that deals 41.3% of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG and inflicts Lux Mark: Radiance for 8s.

potentials.b: When Tilia is in Fortify Stance, deals DMG over time and increases Lux DMG taken by the target.
potentials.d: When Tilia is in Fortify Stance, deals 23.2% of ATK as AoE Lux Skill DMG every 0.25s and increases Lux DMG taken by the target by 3.2% for 8s, stacking up to 10 times.

Increases the Lux DMG taken by targets within the sphere by 18% and inflicts Lux Mark: Radiance on them.

personajes.name: Amber
personajes.profile: The agile dual pistols allow Amber to sashay across the battlefield. Enemies who try to get close to her will turn into ashes long before they can reach her perimeter.

skillsAuto.d: Fires both pistols. Each shot deals 22.7% of ATK as Ignis Auto Attack DMG. Magazine holds 12 ammo.

Fires both pistols in a sweeping motion, dealing 106% x2 and 7.6% x4 of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG, and increasing Auto Attack DMG by 25% for 10s.
Fireworks Jam (Main Skill) can trigger Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame and inflict Incineration, dealing 142% of ATK as AoE Ignis Mark DMG.

Charges forward swiftly, dealing 68% of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG.
Bullet Waltz (Support Skill) can trigger Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame and inflict Incineration, dealing 142% of ATK as AoE Ignis Mark DMG.

Shoots a beam at the target, dealing 1101% of ATK as AoE Ignis Ultimate DMG.
Spark of Finality (Ultimate) can trigger Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame and inflict Incineration, dealing 142% of ATK as AoE Ignis Mark DMG.

potentials.b: After casting the Main Skill, increases Magazine Capacity and Auto Attack DMG.
potentials.d:
After casting Fireworks Jam (Main Skill), immediately reloads 36 rounds in the magazine. 
Increases Auto Attack DMG by 50% before the magazine is depleted.

potentials.b: After casting the Main Skill, Auto Attacks become AoE Attacks.
potentials.d:
After casting Fireworks Jam (Main Skill), immediately fully reloads the magazine. 
Auto Attacks become AoE Attacks before the magazine is depleted, and deal 29.7% of ATK as AoE Ignis Auto Attack DMG.

Within 2s after casting Fireworks Jam (Main Skill), can immediately cast again.
When Fireworks Jam triggers an Ignis Mark: Sacred Flame, casting the Skill again increases its DMG Multiplier by ….

potentials.b: When the Main Skill hits a target, deals extra AoE DMG.

When Fireworks Jam (Main Skill) hits a target, deals an additional 62% of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG. 
This effect can only be triggered 5 times/s.

potentials.b: The Support Skill locks onto and follow the targets.

potentials.d:
While casting Bullet Waltz (Support Skill), generates 2 Shadows every 2s. 
Shadows deal 4.7% of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG every 0.25s for a total of 2.5s.

potentials.b: The Support Skill has a chance to automatically cast again.
potentials.d:
After casting Bullet Waltz (Support Skill), there is a 200000 chance to automatically cast it again. 
Increasing Amber's Crit Hit can improve this effect's trigger chance.

potentials.b: When the Support Skill ends, fires an additional shot.
potentials.d: When Bullet Waltz (Support Skill) ends, Amber fires one additional hit, dealing 113% of ATK as AoE Ignis Skill DMG.

potentials.b: After casting the Ultimate, increases Amber's Base ATK.
potentials.d: After casting Spark of Finality (Ultimate), increases Amber's Base ATK by 46% for 14s.

potentials.d:
Within 5s after Amber hit but didn't kill a target with Spark of Finality (Ultimate), increases her Ignis DMG dealt to the target by …. 
If she kills the target during this period, gains 15 Energy.
